name: exec_command
description: Runs a command in a PTY, returning output or a session ID for ongoing interaction.

workdir.description: Working directory for the command. Defaults to the turn cwd.

tty.description: True allocates a PTY for the command; false or omitted uses plain pipes.

yield_time_ms.description: Wait before yielding output. Defaults to 10000 ms; effective range is 250-30000 ms.

max_output_tokens.description: Output token budget. Defaults to 10000 tokens; larger requests may be capped by policy.

shell.description: Shell binary to launch. Defaults to the user's default shell.

login.description: True runs the shell with -l/-i semantics; false disables them. Defaults to true.

sandbox_permissions.description: Per-command sandbox override. Defaults to `use_default`; use `with_additional_permissions` with `additional_permissions`, or `require_escalated` for unsandboxed execution.

justification.description: User-facing approval question for `require_escalated`; omit otherwise.

prefix_rule.description: Reusable approval prefix for `cmd`, only with `sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated"; for example ["git", "pull"].

additional_permissions.description: Sandboxed filesystem or network access for this command; only with `sandbox_permissions: "with_additional_permissions"`.

chunk_id.description: Chunk identifier included when the response reports one.

wall_time_seconds.description: Elapsed wall time spent waiting for output in seconds.

exit_code.description: Process exit code when the command finished during this call.

session_id.description: Session identifier to pass to write_stdin when the process is still running.

original_token_count.description: Approximate token count before output truncation.

name: write_stdin
description: Writes characters to an existing unified exec session and returns recent output.

session_id.description: Identifier of the running unified exec session.

chars.description: Bytes to write to stdin. Defaults to empty, which polls without writing.

yield_time_ms.description: Wait before yielding output. Non-empty writes default to 250 ms and cap at 30000 ms; empty polls wait 5000-300000 ms by default.

max_output_tokens.description: Output token budget. Defaults to 10000 tokens; larger requests may be capped by policy.

chunk_id.description: Chunk identifier included when the response reports one.

wall_time_seconds.description: Elapsed wall time spent waiting for output in seconds.

exit_code.description: Process exit code when the command finished during this call.

session_id.description: Session identifier to pass to write_stdin when the process is still running.

original_token_count.description: Approximate token count before output truncation.

name: apply_patch
description: The `apply_patch` tool can be used to edit files. This is a FREEFORM tool, so do not wrap the patch in JSON.
